# Code-Development — the Engineering Atlas (contract v2.28.0)

> Route the artifact, verify the change, print every count. A model-aware engineering atlas for polyglot programming, AI coding agents, Git/GitHub, APIs, MCP connectors, storage, verification and release control. GENERATED by `python scripts/atlas.py index --write` from atlas.yaml and the file tree — do not edit.

## Ask the atlas instead of reading it

```bash
python scripts/atlas.py gate <path> <gate>      # the one command a gate runs — ask this first
python scripts/atlas.py route <path> [--json]   # language, card, manifest, label, lane, gates
python scripts/atlas.py plan <path> --task debugging --json
python scripts/atlas.py check                   # exit code IS the verdict
python scripts/atlas.py doctor                  # can THIS machine run each instrument?
python scripts/packprobe.py --mode smoke        # which declared commands run here
```

## Control plane

- [MODEL.md](MODEL.md): the canonical operating model; read before anything else
- [CHAT.md](CHAT.md): for a chat that cannot run code: install text, processes, route table
- [atlas.yaml](atlas.yaml): single source of truth: routes, invariants, gates, profiles, policy
- [docs/INDEX.md](docs/INDEX.md): full document index
- [tools/tools.schema.json](tools/tools.schema.json): JSON Schema for every language tool manifest
- [config/github-labels.json](config/github-labels.json): the label catalog routes resolve against
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): security policy and measured platform controls
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): MIT

## Language packs

Each `languages/<pack>/` holds `README.md` (guide), `OPERATING.md` (card) and `tools.yaml` (manifest), labelled `lang/` + its last path segment. Ask `atlas gate` before reading one.
